# How the numbers work

This page shows the exact sums behind two numbers: the [meta points](basics.md#meta-points) a run pays, and the [Stardust](basics.md#stardust) an ascension pays. Every number here comes from the game's own settings, and the examples are worked out with the same sums.

- "Round down" means drop anything after the decimal point, so 2,961.75 becomes 2,961.
- "The tree" means what the levels you own would cost in meta at today's prices.

## Meta points from a run

A run pays meta when it ends. SAVE & QUIT and leaving the game pay what the run has earned so far, and finishing it later pays the rest, so a run split over several sittings pays exactly what it would in one go.

### Step by step

1. **Score.** Every point the run earned, from tiles, bonuses, jackpots and gates. Points you spend in the shop still count. The start points Trust Fund, War Chest and Foothold give you do not.
2. **Floor.** Take off **0.7 points for every meta point your tree is worth**. That counts every level you own, ascension nodes and levels kept with Stardust included. If nothing is left, the run pays 0.
3. **Curve.** Divide what is left by **500**, take the square root and multiply by **3**.
4. **Tail.** If the curve comes to more than **500**, it becomes 500 + 234 x ln(curve / 500), where ln is the natural log. Past 500 a bigger score still pays more, but much more slowly. The curve reaches 500 at about 13,900,000 points above the floor.
5. **Alchemist.** Multiply by 1 + 0.25 for each level of the Alchemist node, so up to **x2** at level 4.
6. **Ascension.** Multiply by 1 + 0.5 for each of the first 5 ascensions (**x3.5** at 5), plus 0.1 for each of the next 20, so **x5.5** from 25 ascensions on.
7. **Round down.** This is the only rounding in the sum.
8. **Double Meta.** The [pass](store.md) doubles the result, after the round down.

```text
left  = score - 0.7 x tree
curve = 3 x sqrt(left / 500)
if curve > 500:  curve = 500 + 234 x ln(curve / 500)
meta  = round down( curve x (1 + 0.25 x Alchemist) x (1 + 0.5 x min(ascensions, 5) + 0.1 x clamp(ascensions - 5, 0, 20)) )
with Double Meta:  meta x 2
```

### Paid on top

These are added after the sum, so Alchemist, ascensions and Double Meta never raise them:

- Your [daily challenge](daily-challenges.md) reward, 50 to 100 meta by streak.
- Tithe and Magpie [forge](forge.md) faces pay meta the moment they land, up to **120 a run** between them.

### Worked example

A 10,000,000 point run after 5 ascensions, with every node open to you bought (a tree worth 92,318 meta), Alchemist at level 4 and Double Meta:

| Step | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Score | 10,000,000 |
| Floor | 0.7 x 92,318 = 64,622.6 |
| Left after the floor | 9,935,377.4 |
| Curve | 3 x square root of (9,935,377.4 / 500) = 422.89, under 500 |
| Alchemist level 4 | x 2 = 845.78 |
| 5 ascensions | x 3.5 = 2,960.24 |
| Round down | 2,960 |
| Double Meta | x 2 = **5,920** |

And one past the tail: 100,000,000 points on an empty tree gives a curve of 1,341.64. That is over 500, so it becomes 500 + 234 x ln(1,341.64 / 500) = 730.97, which rounds down to **730** meta.

## Stardust from ascending

You can [ascend](basics.md#ascension) when you own every level of every node open to you (levels you kept count), no run is live or saved, and, once you have ascended 5 times, the fee is banked. The ASCEND window shows this same sum as a receipt before you confirm.

### Step by step

1. **Fee.** None for your first 5 ascensions. Your 6th costs **13,000 meta**, and each one after that **200 more**, up to 22,000. It comes out of your banked meta first and pays no Stardust.
2. **Meta traded in.** What your tree is worth, leaving out levels you kept with Stardust, plus the banked meta left after the fee.
3. **Meta part.** Divide by **80** and round down.
4. **Share.** Astrolabe 10% a level, Nebula 25% a level and Singularity 50% a level, added up to a whole percent (at most 105%). Multiply the meta part by it and round down. The share only grows the meta part.
5. **Flat.** 200 for each Star Charter level and 500 for each Zodiac level.
6. **Catch up.** 900 for each ascension you made before Stardust existed. It is paid once, on your next ascension, and most players never see it.
7. **Total.** **250** + meta part + share + flat + catch up.

Every node level is read from the tree you trade in, before it is wiped.

```text
fee       = 0 if ascensions done < 5, else min(22000, 13000 + 200 x (ascensions done - 5))
meta      = tree (not kept) + max(0, banked - fee)
meta part = round down(meta / 80)
share     = round down(meta part x (10% x Astrolabe + 25% x Nebula + 50% x Singularity))
flat      = 200 x Star Charter + 500 x Zodiac
Stardust  = 250 + meta part + share + flat + catch up
```

After it pays, your tree goes back to only the levels you kept and your banked meta goes to 0. Your Stardust, perk fills, start grants, sockets and kept levels all stay.

### Worked example

Your 6th ascension, with every node open to you bought and 10,000 meta banked above the fee:

| Step | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Banked meta | 23,000 |
| Fee | 13,000, which leaves 10,000 |
| Meta in the tree | 92,318 |
| Meta traded in | 92,318 + 10,000 = 102,318 |
| Meta part | 102,318 / 80 = 1,278.97, rounded down to 1,278 |
| Share | 10% x Astrolabe 3 = 30%, so 1,278 x 30% rounded down is 383 |
| Flat | 200 x Star Charter 3 = 600 |
| Total | 250 + 1,278 + 383 + 600 = **2,511** |

### Keeping a level

[Keeping a level](basics.md#keeping-levels) for good costs **500 Stardust + 10 x the level's meta price**, rounded up. A kept level leaves the meta traded in, so it pays no Stardust when you ascend, but it still counts toward the floor a run must pass.

<p class="wiki-version">Numbers on this page match Rogue Roller version 3.1.0.</p>
